heading: INT. COURTHOUSE BASEMENT - EVIDENCE CAGE - DAY

units.text: INT. COURTHOUSE BASEMENT - EVIDENCE CAGE - DAY
A wire-mesh room under flickering fluorescents.
Shelves of banker's boxes, tagged in marker.
A steel table in the middle.
The ceiling pipes drip.
ATTORNEY COLETTE BAPTISTE (40s, pinstripe suit, rolling briefcase) sets a box on the table.
CLERK ARNOLD (60s, cardigan, coin purse of keys) stands at the cage door, a sign-in book open on a stand.
GUARD TREVOR (30s, county uniform, a thermos) leans on the wall, unhurried.
Mr. Arnold, I'd like to inspect Exhibit Fourteen.
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: You'll need to sign the book.
units.name: ARNOLD

units.text: I've signed it.
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: Not the second page.
units.name: ARNOLD

units.text: There's a second page?
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: Since March.
units.name: ARNOLD

units.text: She signs.
Arnold inspects the signature, sniffs, and nods.
Colette opens the box.
She lifts out a plastic bag with a worn leather wallet.
Come on, come on.
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: She slides the wallet out, checks its contents, frowns.
Anything wrong, counselor?
units.name: TREVOR

units.text: No. Just a count.
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: We count everything twice down here.
units.name: TREVOR

units.text: That's reassuring.
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: She peers at the bag's seal.
The tape is peeled at one corner and re-pressed.
Mr. Arnold. When was this box last opened?
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: It's in the log.
units.name: ARNOLD

units.text: I'd like you to read the log aloud.
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: That's not standard.
units.name: ARNOLD

units.text: It's a request.
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: Arnold sighs, flips pages, finds a line, runs his finger along it.
October third. Detective Sahar Qureshi, from Major Crimes.
units.name: ARNOLD

units.text: Not mine.
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: She said it was for a review.
units.name: ARNOLD

units.text: She wasn't on the list.
units.name: TREVOR

units.text: She had a badge.
units.name: ARNOLD

units.text: Badges aren't lists, Arnold.
units.name: TREVOR

units.text: The door at the end of the corridor buzzes.
A heavy tread.
INVESTIGATOR SAHAR QURESHI (40s, trench coat, short hair, a folder under her arm) enters the cage, nods to the room.
Morning, all. I hear someone's asking about me.
units.name: SAHAR

units.text: Detective Qureshi.
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: Counselor. How's the Delacroix case?
units.name: SAHAR

units.text: Not the topic. You opened my exhibit.
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: I opened a lot of exhibits.
units.name: SAHAR

units.text: You re-taped the seal.
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: Did I? I'd have to check.
units.name: SAHAR

units.text: Colette crosses her arms.
Trevor takes a long, noisy sip from his thermos.
Arnold scribbles in his log.
Second page, second page.
units.name: ARNOLD

units.text: I'd be careful what you write, Arnold.
units.name: SAHAR

units.text: I write what's true.
units.name: ARNOLD

units.text: I'll need an affidavit explaining why you accessed Exhibit Fourteen on October third.
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: I'd be glad to.
units.name: SAHAR

units.text: Today.
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: It's Tuesday. Courts close at four.
units.name: SAHAR

units.text: Then you'll have to be fast.
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: Sahar smiles faintly.
She sets her folder on the table and flips it open.
Inside, a thick packet of photographs.
Or I could show you what I found.
units.name: SAHAR

units.text: Colette stares at the photographs.
Her face doesn't change, but her hand drifts to the table edge.
Where did you get those?
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: Inside the wallet's lining.
units.name: SAHAR

units.text: Told you we count twice.
units.name: TREVOR

units.text: Everyone please remember to initial the second page on your way out.
units.name: ARNOLD

units.text: Detective.
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: Counselor.
units.name: SAHAR

units.text: Let's go upstairs.
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: Let's go upstairs.
units.name: ^SAHAR

units.text: Colette takes the box.
Sahar takes the folder.
They walk out side by side.
Trevor and Arnold exchange a look.
That's going to be a long Tuesday.
units.name: TREVOR

units.text: They're always long. That's why we sign.
units.name: ARNOLD
